---
name: Suggest a promise
about: Add a promise that has a primary source and a verbatim quote
title: "Promise: "
---

## Politician

James Talarico or Gina Hinojosa.

## Verbatim quote

Paste the exact words. Do not paraphrase.

## Primary source

URL of the page, post, speech, or video where they said it. A news article that only paraphrases them is not enough.

## Date said

The date on the source, or "not shown".

## Topic

If you know it. Otherwise leave this blank.

## Explicit pledge or platform line

An explicit pledge says they will do something. A platform line is a published position.

## Notes

Anything a reviewer should know. Do not invent a status. New promises start as pending.
